args.answer:
The Animal Haven’s dog-walker role has a published minimum age of 21, so at 15 you don’t meet that requirement; having your dad accompany you doesn’t change it. The role’s application status is “confirm with organization,” and no dog-walking days or shifts are published.

A possible shelter alternative is Dan Cosgrove Animal Shelter in Branford: it welcomes all ages, and anyone under 16 must have a parent or guardian with them at all times—your dad could accompany you on weekends. General volunteers are asked for at least 4 hours per month. Dog duties have additional requirements that aren’t published, and the next orientation date hasn’t been posted, so check with the shelter about those and whether weekend participation is possible.

Another youth-friendly option is organizing a food or supply drive for Branford Compassion Club through a school or youth group; that’s an independent way to help, not a shelter shift.

recommendations.why_relevant: All ages are welcome; volunteers under 16 must be accompanied by a parent/guardian at all times. It asks for at least 4 hours/month, but dog-work requirements and upcoming orientation details need checking.

non_matches.why_not: The Animal Haven publishes a minimum age of 21 for dog walking; you said you are 15. A parent attending does not override that age requirement.

follow_up_questions: Could you commit to at least 4 hours per month at another shelter, and for how many months?
